extraFacts.fact: SAE J512 is the SAE standard for automotive tube fittings; it covers the 45° SAE flare fitting and the inverted flare fitting.
ASME B1.20.3 is the standard for inch Dryseal pipe threads (NPTF), which are made to seal on the thread.
SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2 cover 37° flared (JIC) tube fittings, which seat on a 37° cone.
